name: crypto_id
description: Say which encryption scheme a volume or a file uses, from its header: BitLocker and BitLocker To Go, LUKS1 and LUKS2 with their key slots, FileVault, APFS, VeraCrypt's deliberate lack of a signature, and the encrypted-archive and encrypted-document flags.

path.description: A volume image, a partition, or a file

offset.description: Byte offset of the volume within the image

entropy_sample.description: Bytes to sample for the no-signature case (default 65536)
